healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the Pipedrive token by listing one person.

persons.list.title: List Persons
persons.list.description: List accessible Pipedrive persons with bounded pagination.

organizations.list.title: List Organizations
organizations.list.description: List accessible Pipedrive organizations with bounded pagination.

deals.list.title: List Deals
deals.list.description: List accessible Pipedrive deals with bounded pagination.

persons.get.title: Get Person
persons.get.description: Fetch a Pipedrive person by id via GET /api/v2/persons/{id}.

persons.create.title: Create Person
persons.create.description: Create a Pipedrive person via POST /api/v2/persons. name is required. Emails and phones are objects with value, primary, and label.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary value.

label.description: Classification label such as work or home.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary value.

label.description: Classification label such as work or home.

persons.update.title: Update Person
persons.update.description: Update a Pipedrive person via PATCH /api/v2/persons/{id}. Omitted fields are left unchanged. This is a 30-day soft delete when using Delete Person instead.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary value.

label.description: Classification label such as work or home.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary value.

label.description: Classification label such as work or home.

persons.delete.title: Delete Person
persons.delete.description: Mark a Pipedrive person as deleted via DELETE /api/v2/persons/{id}. After 30 days the person is permanently deleted.

organizations.get.title: Get Organization
organizations.get.description: Fetch a Pipedrive organization by id via GET /api/v2/organizations/{id}.

organizations.create.title: Create Organization
organizations.create.description: Create a Pipedrive organization via POST /api/v2/organizations. name is required.

organizations.update.title: Update Organization
organizations.update.description: Update a Pipedrive organization via PATCH /api/v2/organizations/{id}. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

organizations.delete.title: Delete Organization
organizations.delete.description: Mark a Pipedrive organization as deleted via DELETE /api/v2/organizations/{id}. After 30 days the organization is permanently deleted.

deals.get.title: Get Deal
deals.get.description: Fetch a Pipedrive deal by id via GET /api/v2/deals/{id}.

deals.create.title: Create Deal
deals.create.description: Create a Pipedrive deal via POST /api/v2/deals. title is required. value is a number and currency is an ISO code.

currency.description: ISO currency code, for example USD.

status.description: Deal status: open, won, or lost.

deals.update.title: Update Deal
deals.update.description: Update a Pipedrive deal via PATCH /api/v2/deals/{id}. Omitted fields are left unchanged. status may be open, won, or lost.

currency.description: ISO currency code, for example USD.

status.description: Deal status: open, won, or lost.

deals.delete.title: Delete Deal
deals.delete.description: Mark a Pipedrive deal as deleted via DELETE /api/v2/deals/{id}. After 30 days the deal is permanently deleted.

activities.list.title: List Activities
activities.list.description: List Pipedrive activities via GET /api/v2/activities with bounded cursor pagination and optional deal, person, organization, and done filters.

done.description: If set, only activities with this done flag are returned.

activities.get.title: Get Activity
activities.get.description: Fetch a Pipedrive activity by id via GET /api/v2/activities/{id}.

activities.create.title: Create Activity
activities.create.description: Create a Pipedrive activity via POST /api/v2/activities. Set the linked person through participants with primary true; there is no top-level person_id on v2 create.

type.description: Activity type, for example call or meeting.

busy.description: Whether the assignee is marked busy.

done.description: Whether the activity is marked done.

primary.description: Whether this person is the primary participant.

participants.description: Activity participants. A primary participant sets person_id.

activities.update.title: Update Activity
activities.update.description: Update a Pipedrive activity via PATCH /api/v2/activities/{id}. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Set done true to mark the activity complete.

type.description: Activity type, for example call or meeting.

busy.description: Whether the assignee is marked busy.

done.description: Whether the activity is marked done.

primary.description: Whether this person is the primary participant.

participants.description: Activity participants. A primary participant sets person_id.

notes.list.title: List Notes
notes.list.description: List Pipedrive notes via GET /api/v1/notes. Notes have no v2 endpoint; pagination uses start and limit rather than the v2 cursor.

notes.create.title: Create Note
notes.create.description: Create a Pipedrive note via POST /api/v1/notes. content is required. Attach the note with deal_id, person_id, org_id, or lead_id. Notes remain on API v1.

deal_id.description: Deal to attach the note to.

person_id.description: Person to attach the note to.

org_id.description: Organization to attach the note to.

lead_id.description: Lead to attach the note to.

webhook.deal_added.title: Deal Added
webhook.deal_added.description: Inbound Pipedrive webhook when a deal is added (event added.deal). EventOnly: AppCall records the payload and does not register a bun handler.

webhook.person_added.title: Person Added
webhook.person_added.description: Inbound Pipedrive webhook when a person is added (event added.person). EventOnly: AppCall records the payload and does not register a bun handler.

webhook.activity_added.title: Activity Added
webhook.activity_added.description: Inbound Pipedrive webhook when an activity is added (event added.activity). EventOnly: AppCall records the payload and does not register a bun handler.
